scope: Read-only exhaustive real-frame navigation audit using each actual exported adapter; no Chrome, previews, TTS or production mutation.
method: For each real shot local frame, call navigationState if exported; otherwise call actualNavState with actual spec factory. TCC opening-conflict and Outbox virtual segments use their real adapters. Check finite cameras, projected selected-node bounds, fixed node geometry and focus switches; list mechanism events during zoom for editorial judgment rather than treating them all as failures.
designRevision: v0.47.1 retained in frozen storyboards; site version differs because concurrent main reached v0.49.0
interpretation: p0/p1 focus changes are listed as endpoint/overview cases. Events in overview or zoom can be intentional if the graph carries the explanation; editorial must assess them against the image and narration. A full detail pane extends above y160 by design; only its center must remain in the clipped region, while pane-bounds checks use the full1920x900 plane.
focusChangeCriterion: Only strictly intermediate camera progress (0<p<1) counts as a mid-zoom focus switch. A phase named zoom-in at p=0 is an endpoint, not an intermediate switch.
